careers.name: Full-Stack Software Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and maintains complete web applications from database architecture and backend APIs to frontend user interfaces. Highly versatile developers who understand both client-side presentation and server-side logic.
careers.whyItSuits: Matches students who show creative strength (for UI layout/frontend) coupled with analytical skills (for API design and database modeling), and prioritize remote-work and product ownership.

careers.name: AI/ML Engineer
careers.description: Develops neural networks, machine learning models, and algorithms to automate data-driven decisions and build intelligent systems. Essential role in modern industries leveraging big data, automation, and predictive analytics.
careers.whyItSuits: Suits students with strong analytical skills, math-heavy academic backgrounds, and goals oriented toward R&D, innovation, and high-tech research.

careers.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protects an organization's network, servers, and data systems from cyber threats, unauthorized access, and data breaches. Analyzes security infrastructure, performs penetrations tests, and builds defenses.
careers.whyItSuits: Ideal for detail-oriented, systematic thinkers interested in infrastructure, networking protocols, security standards, and defense strategies.

careers.name: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Bridges the gap between software developers and IT staff. Automates software delivery pipelines, manages cloud infrastructure, and monitors application reliability at scale.
careers.whyItSuits: Fits students who love system automation, scripting, server management, and optimizing workflow pipelines to ensure massive application scaling.

careers.name: Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer
careers.description: Writes low-level firmware that directly interacts with physical hardware microcontrollers and microprocessors. Integrates hardware and software to power smart devices, robotics, and automotive systems.
careers.whyItSuits: Highly recommended for Electrical, Electronics, or Robotics students who enjoy hardware interaction, low-level programming (C/C++), and working with microcontrollers.
